# Poker with AI

> Poker with AI (https://pokerwithai.net) is a web game where you play No-Limit Texas
> Hold'em poker against AI characters powered by large language models — Claude, GPT,
> Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, and Sakana. The AI rivals
> talk at the table, bluff, react to bad beats, and keep private notes on how you play.
> Every seat can run a different LLM, so each game doubles as a live model comparison.
> Free to play; a paid pay-as-you-go tier unlocks the full model catalog.

## How it works

- You name a theme (Dune, 1920s Chicago, Cyberpunk…) and an AI game master writes the
  scene and deals themed rival characters, each played by an LLM you can choose.
- Real No-Limit Hold'em underneath: climbing blinds, side pots, showdowns resolved by
  a proper poker engine — the storytelling never changes the poker math.
- The table talks: characters needle you mid-hand, an LLM "Pit Boss" decides who
  speaks, and rivals remember previous hands via compacted memory.

## Pages

- [Home](https://pokerwithai.net): what the game is, how a night unfolds, pricing.
- [Rules](https://pokerwithai.net/rules): the sit-n-go format, blinds schedule, the
  rivals' memory system, table-talk budget, free-tier limits.
- [Models](https://pokerwithai.net/models): the full catalog of ~24 models from 11
  labs you can seat at the table, with per-model costs and availability by tier.

## Common questions this site answers

- Can AI play poker? Can ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini play Texas Hold'em?
- Which LLM is best at poker or bluffing?
- Play poker against AI opponents online, with table talk, free.
